evidence: Has RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies `src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp` to surface descriptive internal errors and pruned block errors rather than "not found".
rationale: Improves RPC response correctness by distinguishing disk read failures from nonexistent transactions. As the author notes, "Currently the GetTransaction return value is a nullable transaction pointer, where nullptr represents two different outcomes: I/O error and missing tx. Reporting a confirmed transaction as missing is wrong, so properly return an error instead."
